text.ms:
1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Pendidikan (Penggal Institusi Pendidikan Tahun 2020) 2019.

Pemakaian

2. Peraturan-Peraturan ini terpakai bagi kehadiran di institusi pendidikan bagi

tahun 2020.

Tempoh penggal institusi pendidikan

3. Tempoh penggal institusi pendidikan bagi tahun 2020 adalah sebagaimana yang

dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

Kumpulan A Penggal Pertama

Semua institusi pendidikan di Kedah,

Kelantan, Terengganu dan Johor

1 Januari 2020 hingga 12 Mac 2020

22 Mac 2020 hingga 21 Mei 2020

Penggal Kedua

7 Jun 2020 hingga 23 Julai 2020

2 Ogos 2010 hingga 19 November 2020

Kumpulan B Penggal Pertama

Semua institusi pendidikan di Perlis,

Pulau Pinang, Perak, Selangor,

Negeri Sembilan, Melaka, Pahang, Sabah,

Sarawak, Wilayah Persekutuan

Kuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan

Labuan dan Wilayah Persekutuan

Putrajaya

2 Januari 2020 hingga 13 Mac 2020

23 Mac 2020 hingga 22 Mei 2020

Penggal Kedua

8 Jun 2020 hingga 24 Julai 2020

3 Ogos 2020 hingga 20 November 2020

Dibuat 27 November 2019

[KPMSP.100-1/7/1; PN(PU2)569/XIV]

DR. MASZLEE BIN MALIK

Menteri Pendidikan

EDUCATION ACT 1996

EDUCATION (TERMS OF EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS YEAR 2020)

REGULATIONS 2019

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 130(2)(b) of the

Education Act 1996 [Act 550], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Education (Terms of Educational

Institutions Year 2020) Regulations 2019.

Application

2. These Regulations shall apply to attendance at educational institutions for the

year 2020.

Duration of terms of educational institutions

3. The duration of terms of educational institutions for the year 2020 shall be as

specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Group A First Term

All educational institutions in Kedah,

Kelantan, Terengganu and Johore

1 January 2020 to 12 March 2020

22 March 2020 to 21 May 2020

Second Term

7 June 2020 to 23 July 2020

2 August 2010 to 19 November 2020

Group B First Term

All educational institutions in Perlis,

Penang, Perak, Selangor, Negeri Sembilan,

Malacca, Pahang, Sabah, Sarawak, Federal

Territory of Kuala Lumpur, Federal

Territory of Labuan and Federal Territory

of Putrajaya

2 January 2020 to 13 March 2020

23 March 2020 to 22 May 2020

Second Term

8 June 2020 to 24 July 2020

3 August 2020 to 20 November 2020

Made 27 November 2019

[KPMSP.100-1/7/1; PN(PU2)569/XIV]

DR. MASZLEE BIN MALIK

Minister of Education
